sources.name: Pravah-AI public dam storage
sources.note: WRD-branded public feed; publisher authority not independently confirmed. Context only; no name-based merge with NWIC and no village supply inference. 840 records have no valid coordinate.

sources.name: JJM village schemes, sources and service areas
sources.note: Public village details exist; bulk authenticated API requires registration and approval. JJM village IDs are not assumed equal to LGD IDs. Scheme record is not a current-flow measurement.

sources.name: JJM API help guide v1.02 (PDF)
sources.note: Documents registration, competent-authority approval, API permissions and bearer token. No account or application has been submitted.

sources.name: Sujalam Bharat source-to-tap data sharing
sources.note: Policy published 20 August 2026. Request scheme/service-area IDs and source-to-tap asset exports from the State JJM/WSSD authority; no public statewide export verified.

sources.name: MRSAC / GSDA GIS
sources.note: Public configuration references admin2011 village/state boundaries. Excluded under the current-data requirement; no modern village geometry or drinking-water pipeline feed verified.

sources.name: Maharashtra WRD official storage portal
sources.note: WRD links mwrdpravah.in/damstorage; retrieval of that portal and the public storage PDF failed TLS verification here. No unverified figures were extracted from it.

sources.name: IMD weather forecast API
sources.note: Previously checked forecast endpoint returned 401. No future rainfall is invented; existing Open-Meteo integration remains a separately labelled non-government grid forecast.

sources.name: Village operations: DMA, tanks, pumps, meters and deliveries
sources.note: Need dated surveyed pipelines, valve/pump operation, inlet/outlet meters, tank levels/capacity, tanker delivery logs and source yields. No statewide public operational feed verified.

sources.name: Current village demand and population
sources.note: Household connections are not persons or consumption. No 2011 population or assumed household size is substituted; agriculture/livestock/industrial demand also need current local records.

sources.name: MIDC public industrial water-network GIS
sources.note: 660 pipe features, 175 valves, 32 tanks/reservoirs, 7 pump houses, 6 treatment plants and 1 intake at audit. Industrial network only; survey/update date unknown. Flow-meter and water-meter layers are empty. No rural village service connection is inferred.

sources.name: MRSAC WSSD scheme-point and pipeline services
sources.note: Public configuration lists PWS/regional/spot scheme points and PWS/regional pipe lines. All five referenced service metadata requests failed TLS retrieval here. No village service links or geometry were fabricated.

sources.name: PoCRA agricultural water-budget portal
sources.note: Public code includes modelled crop deficit/soil-moisture layers. A budget request hard-codes 2025-06-08; the footer uses yesterday’s system date. Neither proves current measured village supply. Not imported as current drinking-water demand or delivery.
